# Scope

This diagnostic uses the persisted sample-level metadata for the twelve active
`batch_effect_uncorrected` cohorts. It shows how each biological-label group is
represented across configured and extended batch covariates. Bars are normalized
within each biological-label group to 100%, while stack labels retain the number
of unique samples. A potential-confounding flag is descriptive only: a batch
level is flagged when it occurs in exactly one biological-label group. This
notebook does not remove batches, rerun preprocessing, or run statistical tests.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (basename(getwd()) == "notebooks") {
  setwd("..")
  if (file.exists(".Rprofile")) source(".Rprofile")
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(arrow)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(patchwork)
  library(viridis)
})
source("src/utils/datasets_io.R")
source("src/utils/batch_effect_analysis.R")
source("src/utils/plotting.R")

detected_cores <- parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE)
if (is.na(detected_cores)) detected_cores <- 1L
parallel_cores <- min(8L, max(1L, detected_cores))
options(mc.cores = parallel_cores)
n_permutations <- 999L



batch_datasets <- c(
  "Alzheimer",
  "Breast_cancer",
  "Covid19_PBMC",
  "Kidney_KPMP_full",
  "Myocardial_infarction",
  "Diabetes",
  "Lupus_PBMC",
  "Lung",
  "Parkinson",
  "Joanito",
  "Stephenson",
  "CombinedPBMC"
)

input_root <- file.path(getwd(), "data", "batch_effect", "uncorrected")
metadata_root <- file.path(input_root, "metadata")
results_root <- file.path(input_root, "results")
plot_root <- file.path(getwd(), "plots", "batch_effect_uncorrected_batchconfounding")
dir.create(plot_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

datasets <- read_datasets_json(view = "batch_effect_uncorrected")
if (!all(batch_datasets %in% names(datasets))) {
  stop("datasets.json does not contain every active batch-effect dataset")
}
datasets <- datasets[batch_datasets]
if (!identical(names(datasets), batch_datasets)) {
  stop("active batch-effect dataset order is not authoritative")
}

registry <- batch_candidate_registry(datasets, batch_datasets)
```

# Metadata and candidate helpers

```{r metadata-helpers, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
.as_character_vector <- function(value) {
  if (is.null(value) || length(value) == 0L) return(character())
  values <- as.character(unlist(value, use.names = FALSE))
  values <- trimws(values)
  unique(values[nzchar(values) & !is.na(values)])
}

.display_values <- function(value) {
  values <- .batch_values(value)
  values <- trimws(values)
  values[is.na(values) | !nzchar(values)] <- "Missing/unknown"
  values
}

.metadata_artifact_paths <- function(dataset_key) {
  list(
    summary = file.path(results_root, paste0(dataset_key, "_batch_effect_uncorrected_metadata.rds")),
    metadata = file.path(metadata_root, paste0(dataset_key, "_sample_metadata.feather"))
  )
}

.resolve_metadata_source <- function(dataset) {
  canonical <- .metadata_artifact_paths(dataset)
  if (all(file.exists(unlist(canonical)))) {
    return(list(
      source_dataset_key = dataset,
      source_status = "canonical",
      paths = canonical
    ))
  }

  if (identical(dataset, "Kidney_KPMP_full")) {
    legacy <- .metadata_artifact_paths("Kidney_KPMP")
    if (all(file.exists(unlist(legacy)))) {
      warning(
        "Kidney_KPMP_full metadata artifacts are unavailable; using the existing ",
        "Kidney_KPMP artifacts explicitly as a legacy source for this diagnostic."
      )
      return(list(
        source_dataset_key = "Kidney_KPMP",
        source_status = "legacy_Kidney_KPMP_fallback",
        paths = legacy
      ))
    }
  }

  stop("missing validated metadata artifacts for active dataset ", dataset)
}

.read_sample_metadata <- function(dataset) {
  source <- .resolve_metadata_source(dataset)
  validate_batch_artifact(source$paths$summary, "metadata summary")
  summary <- tryCatch(
    readRDS(source$paths$summary),
    error = function(error) {
      stop("malformed metadata summary ", source$paths$summary, ": ", conditionMessage(error))
    }
  )
  labels <- summary$labels
  if (is.null(labels) || is.null(names(labels)) || anyNA(names(labels)) ||
      any(!nzchar(names(labels))) || anyDuplicated(names(labels)) || anyNA(labels)) {
    stop(dataset, ": metadata summary labels are malformed")
  }
  sample_ids <- as.character(names(labels))
  if (!identical(as.integer(summary$n_samples), length(sample_ids))) {
    stop(dataset, ": metadata summary sample count mismatch")
  }
  label_col <- as.character(datasets[[dataset]]$label_col)
  metadata <- read_batch_metadata_sidecar(
    source$paths$metadata,
    expected_sample_ids = sample_ids,
    required_label = label_col
  )
  list(
    dataset = dataset,
    metadata = metadata,
    label_col = label_col,
    sample_ids = sample_ids,
    source_dataset_key = source$source_dataset_key,
    source_status = source$source_status,
    source_paths = source$paths
  )
}

configured_candidates <- function(dataset) {
  candidates <- .as_character_vector(datasets[[dataset]]$batch_col)
  data.frame(
    covariate = candidates,
    candidate_class = rep("configured_batch", length(candidates)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

extended_candidates <- function(dataset) {
  rows <- registry[registry$dataset == dataset & !registry$is_primary, , drop = FALSE]
  excluded <- switch(
    dataset,
    Covid19_PBMC = "PatientID",
    Lupus_PBMC = "ind_cov_batch_cov",
    character()
  )
  rows <- rows[!rows$candidate %in% excluded, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(rows) == 0L) {
    return(data.frame(
      covariate = character(),
      candidate_class = character(),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  rows <- rows[!duplicated(rows$candidate), c("candidate", "candidate_class"), drop = FALSE]
  names(rows) <- c("covariate", "candidate_class")
  rownames(rows) <- NULL
  rows
}

.unavailable_summary_row <- function(
  metadata_info,
  plot_type,
  covariate,
  candidate_class,
  availability_status,
  availability_note
) {
  data.frame(
    dataset = metadata_info$dataset,
    plot_type = plot_type,
    source_dataset_key = metadata_info$source_dataset_key,
    source_status = metadata_info$source_status,
    biological_label = metadata_info$label_col,
    covariate = covariate,
    candidate_class = candidate_class,
    batch_level = NA_character_,
    sample_count = 0L,
    biological_groups = NA_character_,
    n_biological_groups = 0L,
    potential_confounding = FALSE,
    availability_status = availability_status,
    availability_note = availability_note,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

.candidate_data <- function(metadata_info, plot_type, covariate, candidate_class) {
  metadata <- metadata_info$metadata
  if (!covariate %in% colnames(metadata)) {
    return(list(
      plot = NULL,
      summary = .unavailable_summary_row(
        metadata_info, plot_type, covariate, candidate_class,
        "MISSING", "column is absent from the sample metadata Feather"
      )
    ))
  }

  biological <- .display_values(metadata[[metadata_info$label_col]])
  batch <- .batch_values(metadata[[covariate]])
  if (all(is.na(batch))) {
    return(list(
      plot = NULL,
      summary = .unavailable_summary_row(
        metadata_info, plot_type, covariate, candidate_class,
        "NO_NONMISSING", "column has no non-missing sample values"
      )
    ))
  }

  batch <- .display_values(batch)
  frame <- data.frame(
    biological_group = biological,
    batch_level = batch,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  bio_levels <- unique(frame$biological_group)
  batch_levels <- unique(frame$batch_level)
  frame$biological_group <- factor(frame$biological_group, levels = bio_levels)
  frame$batch_level <- factor(frame$batch_level, levels = batch_levels)
  counts <- as.data.frame(table(frame$biological_group, frame$batch_level), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(counts) <- c("biological_group", "batch_level", "sample_count")
  counts <- counts[counts$sample_count > 0L, , drop = FALSE]
  counts$biological_group <- as.character(counts$biological_group)
  counts$batch_level <- as.character(counts$batch_level)
  totals <- tapply(counts$sample_count, counts$biological_group, sum)
  counts$percentage <- 100 * counts$sample_count / as.numeric(totals[counts$biological_group])
  counts$dataset <- metadata_info$dataset
  counts$plot_type <- plot_type
  counts$source_dataset_key <- metadata_info$source_dataset_key
  counts$source_status <- metadata_info$source_status
  counts$biological_label <- metadata_info$label_col
  counts$covariate <- covariate
  counts$candidate_class <- candidate_class
  counts$fill_key <- paste(covariate, counts$batch_level, sep = ": ")
  groups_by_level <- split(counts$biological_group, counts$batch_level)
  level_names <- names(groups_by_level)
  level_summary <- data.frame(
    batch_level = level_names,
    sample_count = vapply(
      level_names,
      function(level) sum(counts$sample_count[counts$batch_level == level]),
      integer(1)
    ),
    biological_groups = vapply(
      level_names,
      function(level) paste(
        unique(counts$biological_group[counts$batch_level == level]),
        collapse = "; "
      ),
      character(1)
    ),
    n_biological_groups = vapply(
      level_names,
      function(level) length(unique(counts$biological_group[counts$batch_level == level])),
      integer(1)
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  level_summary$potential_confounding <- level_summary$n_biological_groups == 1L
  level_summary$dataset <- metadata_info$dataset
  level_summary$plot_type <- plot_type
  level_summary$source_dataset_key <- metadata_info$source_dataset_key
  level_summary$source_status <- metadata_info$source_status
  level_summary$biological_label <- metadata_info$label_col
  level_summary$covariate <- covariate
  level_summary$candidate_class <- candidate_class
  level_summary$availability_status <- "AVAILABLE"
  level_summary$availability_note <- ""
  level_summary[, c(
    "dataset", "plot_type", "source_dataset_key", "source_status",
    "biological_label", "covariate", "candidate_class", "batch_level",
    "sample_count", "biological_groups", "n_biological_groups",
    "potential_confounding", "availability_status", "availability_note"
  )] -> summary
  list(plot = counts, summary = summary)
}
```

# Grouped stacked plot builder

```{r plotting-helpers, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
.build_plot <- function(metadata_info, candidate_specs, plot_type) {
  if (nrow(candidate_specs) == 0L) {
    blank <- ggplot() +
      theme_void() +
      labs(
        title = paste0(metadata_info$dataset, " - ", plot_type),
        subtitle = paste0("No candidate covariates are registered for this plot family; n = ", length(metadata_info$sample_ids))
      )
    return(list(plot = blank, summary = .unavailable_summary_row(
      metadata_info, plot_type, "<none>", "none", "NO_CANDIDATES", "no candidate covariates are registered"
    )))
  }

  results <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(candidate_specs)), function(index) {
    .candidate_data(
      metadata_info,
      plot_type,
      candidate_specs$covariate[[index]],
      candidate_specs$candidate_class[[index]]
    )
  })
  plot_rows <- lapply(results, `[[`, "plot")
  plot_rows <- plot_rows[!vapply(plot_rows, is.null, logical(1))]
  summary_rows <- lapply(results, `[[`, "summary")
  summary_rows <- do.call(rbind, summary_rows)

  if (length(plot_rows) == 0L) {
    blank <- ggplot() +
      theme_void() +
      labs(
        title = paste0(metadata_info$dataset, " - ", plot_type),
        subtitle = paste0("No candidate covariates have usable values; n = ", length(metadata_info$sample_ids))
      )
    return(list(plot = blank, summary = summary_rows))
  }

  plot_data <- do.call(rbind, plot_rows)
  covariate_levels <- candidate_specs$covariate[candidate_specs$covariate %in% unique(plot_data$covariate)]
  biological_levels <- unique(.display_values(metadata_info$metadata[[metadata_info$label_col]]))
  plot_data$biological_group <- factor(plot_data$biological_group, levels = biological_levels)
  plot_data$covariate <- factor(plot_data$covariate, levels = covariate_levels)
  plot_data$fill_key <- factor(plot_data$fill_key, levels = unique(plot_data$fill_key))

  n_covariates <- length(covariate_levels)
  bar_spacing <- 0.82 / max(1, n_covariates)
  plot_data$bio_index <- match(plot_data$biological_group, biological_levels)
  plot_data$covariate_index <- match(plot_data$covariate, covariate_levels)
  plot_data$x_position <- plot_data$bio_index +
    (plot_data$covariate_index - (n_covariates + 1) / 2) * bar_spacing
  bar_centers <- unique(plot_data[, c("x_position", "covariate"), drop = FALSE])
  bar_centers$covariate <- as.character(bar_centers$covariate)

  fill_levels <- levels(plot_data$fill_key)
  fill_values <- stats::setNames(
    grDevices::hcl(
      h = seq(15, 375, length.out = length(fill_levels) + 1L)[-length(fill_levels) - 1L],
      l = 65,
      c = 100
    ),
    fill_levels
  )
  flagged <- unique(as.character(summary_rows$covariate[summary_rows$potential_confounding]))
  flagged <- flagged[!is.na(flagged) & nzchar(flagged)]
  warning_text <- if (length(flagged) > 0L) {
    paste0("Potential confounding: ", paste(flagged, collapse = ", "))
  } else {
    "Potential confounding: none by the one-biological-group rule"
  }
  subtitle <- paste0(
    "Biological label: ", metadata_info$label_col,
    " | n = ", length(metadata_info$sample_ids), " unique samples",
    " | ", plot_type,
    " | ", warning_text
  )

  plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x_position, y = percentage, fill = fill_key)) +
    geom_col(
      width = bar_spacing * 0.82,
      position = "stack",
      colour = "white",
      linewidth = 0.15
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = paste0("n = ", sample_count)),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 2.5,
      colour = "black"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = bar_centers,
      aes(x = x_position, y = 103, label = covariate),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      size = 2.4
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(biological_levels),
      labels = biological_levels,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.08))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 115),
      breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
      labels = function(value) paste0(value, "%"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_values, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(metadata_info$dataset, " - sample-level batch representation"),
      subtitle = subtitle,
      x = "Biological label",
      y = "Samples within biological group",
      fill = "Batch covariate: level",
      caption = paste0(
        "Stack labels are unique-sample counts. Source: ",
        metadata_info$source_dataset_key, " (", metadata_info$source_status, ")."
      )
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.35, "cm"),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 26, 8)
    )
  list(plot = plot, summary = summary_rows)
}

.save_plot <- function(plot, path, width = 14, height = 8) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(path, plot = plot, width = width, height = height, units = "in", device = "pdf")
  if (!file.exists(path) || is.na(file.info(path)$size) || file.info(path)$size <= 0) {
    stop("empty plot output: ", path)
  }
  invisible(path)
}
.covid_sampling_day_col <- "Sampling day (Days after symptom onset)"

.covid_sampling_day_plot <- function(metadata_info, candidate_spec) {
  result <- .candidate_data(
    metadata_info,
    plot_type = "extended",
    covariate = candidate_spec$covariate[[1L]],
    candidate_class = candidate_spec$candidate_class[[1L]]
  )
  if (is.null(result$plot)) {
    return(result)
  }

  data <- result$plot
  raw_levels <- tolower(trimws(as.character(data$batch_level)))
  data$day_value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(data$batch_level)))
  data$day_value[raw_levels == "control"] <- 0
  data$day_value[raw_levels %in% c("unknown", "missing/unknown")] <- NA_real_
  if (!any(is.finite(data$day_value))) {
    return(list(
      plot = NULL,
      summary = result$summary
    ))
  }

  biological_levels <- unique(.display_values(metadata_info$metadata[[metadata_info$label_col]]))
  data$biological_group <- factor(data$biological_group, levels = biological_levels)
  data$bio_index <- match(data$biological_group, biological_levels)
  finite_days <- data$day_value[is.finite(data$day_value)]
  upper_day <- max(finite_days)
  day_breaks <- unique(c(0, 15, 30, ceiling(upper_day / 10) * 10))
  flagged <- unique(as.character(result$summary$covariate[result$summary$potential_confounding]))
  flagged <- flagged[!is.na(flagged) & nzchar(flagged)]
  warning_text <- if (length(flagged) > 0L) {
    paste0("Potential confounding: ", paste(flagged, collapse = ", "))
  } else {
    "Potential confounding: none by the one-biological-group rule"
  }

  plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = bio_index, y = percentage, fill = day_value)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.68, position = "stack", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = paste0("n = ", sample_count)),
      position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
      size = 2.5,
      colour = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_along(biological_levels),
      labels = biological_levels,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 100),
      breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
      labels = function(value) paste0(value, "%"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    viridis::scale_fill_viridis(
      option = "viridis",
      direction = -1,
      na.value = "grey70",
      breaks = day_breaks,
      limits = c(0, max(day_breaks)),
      name = "Sampling day\n(days; 0 = control)"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Covid19_PBMC - Sampling day",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Biological label: ", metadata_info$label_col,
        " | n = ", length(metadata_info$sample_ids), " unique samples",
        " | ", warning_text
      ),
      x = "Biological label",
      y = "Samples within biological group",
      caption = "Controls are mapped to day 0; nonnumeric unknown values are grey."
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 12, 8)
    )
  list(plot = plot, summary = result$summary)
}

.build_covid_extended_plot <- function(metadata_info, candidate_specs) {
  categorical_specs <- candidate_specs[
    !candidate_specs$covariate %in% c("PatientID", .covid_sampling_day_col),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  categorical <- .build_plot(metadata_info, categorical_specs, "extended")
  day_spec <- candidate_specs[candidate_specs$covariate == .covid_sampling_day_col, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(day_spec) == 0L) return(categorical)

  day <- .covid_sampling_day_plot(metadata_info, day_spec)
  if (is.null(day$plot)) {
    return(list(
      plot = categorical$plot,
      summary = rbind(categorical$summary, day$summary)
    ))
  }
  combined <- categorical$plot / day$plot +
    patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(2.8, 1.4), guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  list(
    plot = combined,
    summary = rbind(categorical$summary, day$summary)
  )
}

.read_temporal_rds <- function(path, kind) {
  if (!file.exists(path) || isTRUE(file.info(path)$isdir) || file.info(path)$size <= 0) {
    stop(kind, " is missing or empty: ", path)
  }
  fields <- .batch_sidecar_fields(path)
  actual_md5 <- unname(tools::md5sum(path))
  actual_size <- as.character(file.info(path)$size)
  if (!identical(tolower(as.character(fields$MD5)), tolower(actual_md5))) {
    stop(kind, " MD5 mismatch: ", path)
  }
  if (!identical(as.character(fields$SIZE), actual_size)) {
    stop(kind, " SIZE mismatch: ", path)
  }
  expected_path <- normalizePath(path, mustWork = FALSE)
  if (!identical(as.character(fields$PATH), expected_path)) {
    warning(
      kind, " is a validated local mirror with recorded source path '",
      fields$PATH, "': ", path,
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  tryCatch(
    readRDS(path),
    error = function(error) stop("malformed ", kind, " ", path, ": ", conditionMessage(error))
  )
}

.validate_temporal_features <- function(features, method, expected_sample_ids) {
  if (!is.matrix(features) && !is.data.frame(features)) {
    stop(method, " feature matrix is not tabular")
  }
  features <- as.matrix(features)
  if (is.null(rownames(features)) || anyNA(rownames(features)) ||
      any(!nzchar(rownames(features))) || anyDuplicated(rownames(features))) {
    stop(method, " feature matrix has invalid sample IDs")
  }
  if (!setequal(rownames(features), expected_sample_ids)) {
    stop(method, " feature matrix sample IDs do not match metadata")
  }
  storage.mode(features) <- "double"
  if (any(!is.finite(features))) stop(method, " feature matrix contains non-finite values")
  features[expected_sample_ids, , drop = FALSE]
}

.load_covid_temporal_features <- function(metadata_info) {
  composition_path <- file.path(
    input_root,
    "results",
    "Covid19_PBMC_batch_effect_uncorrected_composition.rds"
  )
  pseudobulk_path <- file.path(
    input_root,
    "results",
    "Covid19_PBMC_batch_effect_uncorrected_pseudobulk.rds"
  )
  composition <- .read_temporal_rds(composition_path, "Covid19 ECODA composition RDS")
  pseudobulk <- .read_temporal_rds(pseudobulk_path, "Covid19 pseudobulk RDS")
  if (is.null(composition$ECODA_authors_HR$feat_mat)) {
    stop("Covid19 ECODA composition RDS lacks ECODA_authors_HR$feat_mat")
  }
  if (is.null(pseudobulk$Pseudobulk_hvg2000$feat_mat)) {
    stop("Covid19 pseudobulk RDS lacks Pseudobulk_hvg2000$feat_mat")
  }
  expected_sample_ids <- as.character(metadata_info$sample_ids)
  list(
    ECODA = .validate_temporal_features(
      composition$ECODA_authors_HR$feat_mat,
      "ECODA",
      expected_sample_ids
    ),
    Pseudobulk = .validate_temporal_features(
      pseudobulk$Pseudobulk_hvg2000$feat_mat,
      "Pseudobulk",
      expected_sample_ids
    )
  )
}

.covid_time_bins <- function(metadata_info) {
  metadata <- metadata_info$metadata
  day <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(metadata[[.covid_sampling_day_col]])))
  severity <- tolower(trimws(as.character(metadata[[metadata_info$label_col]])))
  is_control <- severity == "control"
  masks <- list(
    control_and_le15 = is_control | (!is_control & is.finite(day) & day <= 15),
    day15_30 = !is_control & is.finite(day) & day > 15 & day <= 30,
    day30_max = !is_control & is.finite(day) & day > 30
  )
  assigned <- Reduce("+", lapply(masks, as.integer))
  union_mask <- assigned > 0L
  if (any(assigned > 1L)) {
    stop("Covid19 temporal bins overlap")
  }
  list(
    masks = masks,
    summary = data.frame(
      time_bin = names(masks),
      n_samples = vapply(masks, sum, integer(1)),
      biological_groups = vapply(
        masks,
        function(mask) paste(unique(as.character(metadata[[metadata_info$label_col]][mask])), collapse = "; "),
        character(1)
      ),
      omitted_samples = sum(!union_mask),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
}

.blank_temporal_plot <- function(title, subtitle) {
  ggplot() + theme_void() + labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle)
}

.build_covid_temporal_plots <- function(metadata_info) {
  temporal_features <- .load_covid_temporal_features(metadata_info)
  bins <- .covid_time_bins(metadata_info)
  temporal_plot_root <- file.path(plot_root, "covid19_time_bins")
  dir.create(temporal_plot_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  method_titles <- c(ECODA = "ECODA authors HR", Pseudobulk = "Pseudobulk hvg2000")
  anosim_rows <- list()
  row_index <- 0L

  for (bin_name in names(bins$masks)) {
    mask <- bins$masks[[bin_name]]
    selected_ids <- rownames(metadata_info$metadata)[mask]
    labels <- factor(as.character(metadata_info$metadata[selected_ids, metadata_info$label_col]))
    mds_plots <- lapply(names(temporal_features), function(method) {
      features <- temporal_features[[method]][selected_ids, , drop = FALSE]
      dist_mat <- stats::dist(features)
      anosim <- compute_batch_anosim(
        dist_mat,
        labels,
        permutations = n_permutations,
        parallel = parallel_cores
      )
      row_index <<- row_index + 1L
      anosim_rows[[row_index]] <<- data.frame(
        dataset = "Covid19_PBMC",
        method = method,
        time_bin = bin_name,
        n_samples = length(selected_ids),
        biological_groups = paste(levels(droplevels(labels)), collapse = "; "),
        anosim_statistic = anosim$statistic,
        anosim_p_value = anosim$p_value,
        status = anosim$status,
        warning = anosim$warning,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      if (!identical(anosim$status, "ESTIMABLE")) {
        return(.blank_temporal_plot(
          paste0("Covid19_PBMC - ", method_titles[[method]], " - ", bin_name),
          paste0("ANOSIM unavailable: ", anosim$warning)
        ))
      }
      plot_mds(
        dist_mat,
        labels,
        title = paste0("Covid19_PBMC - ", method_titles[[method]], " - ", bin_name),
        cluster_score = FALSE,
        mod_score = FALSE,
        sil_score = FALSE,
        anosim_score = TRUE,
        anosim_value = anosim$statistic,
        digits = 3,
        parallel = parallel_cores
      )
    })
    names(mds_plots) <- names(temporal_features)
    panel <- patchwork::wrap_plots(mds_plots, ncol = 2, guides = "collect") &
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
    .save_plot(
      panel,
      file.path(temporal_plot_root, paste0("Covid19_PBMC_", bin_name, "_mds.pdf")),
      width = 12,
      height = 6
    )
  }

  anosim_summary <- do.call(rbind, anosim_rows)
  anosim_summary$time_bin <- factor(
    anosim_summary$time_bin,
    levels = names(bins$masks),
    labels = c("Control / <=15", "15-30", "30-max")
  )
  anosim_plot <- ggplot(
    anosim_summary,
    aes(x = time_bin, y = anosim_statistic, colour = method, group = method)
  ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_point(size = 2.4, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = ifelse(is.finite(anosim_statistic), sprintf("%.3f", anosim_statistic), "NA")),
      vjust = -0.8,
      size = 3,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(ECODA = "#0072B2", Pseudobulk = "#D55E00")) +
    labs(
      title = "Covid19_PBMC - ANOSIM by symptom-onset time bin",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Groups: ", metadata_info$label_col,
        " | controls are always in the first bin",
        " | omitted samples: ", bins$summary$omitted_samples[[1L]]
      ),
      x = "Sampling-day bin",
      y = "ANOSIM statistic",
      colour = "Method"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  .save_plot(
    anosim_plot,
    file.path(temporal_plot_root, "Covid19_PBMC_time_bins_anosim.pdf"),
    width = 9,
    height = 6
  )
  write_batch_analysis_table(
    as.data.frame(anosim_summary, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    file.path(temporal_plot_root, "Covid19_PBMC_time_bins_anosim.csv")
  )
  list(
    bins = bins$summary,
    anosim = anosim_summary,
    output_root = temporal_plot_root
  )
}
```

# Generate both plot families

```{r generate-plots, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
metadata_results <- lapply(batch_datasets, .read_sample_metadata)
names(metadata_results) <- batch_datasets

summary_rows <- list()
summary_index <- 0L
for (dataset in batch_datasets) {
  metadata_info <- metadata_results[[dataset]]
  candidate_sets <- list(
    configured = configured_candidates(dataset),
    extended = extended_candidates(dataset)
  )
  for (plot_type in names(candidate_sets)) {
    built <- if (identical(dataset, "Covid19_PBMC") && identical(plot_type, "extended")) {
      .build_covid_extended_plot(metadata_info, candidate_sets[[plot_type]])
    } else {
      .build_plot(metadata_info, candidate_sets[[plot_type]], plot_type)
    }

    output_name <- if (identical(plot_type, "configured")) {
      paste0(dataset, ".pdf")
    } else {
      paste0(dataset, "_extended.pdf")
    }

    .save_plot(built$plot, file.path(plot_root, output_name))
    summary_index <- summary_index + 1L
    summary_rows[[summary_index]] <- built$summary
  }
  }


batch_confounding_summary <- do.call(rbind, summary_rows)
if (is.null(batch_confounding_summary) || nrow(batch_confounding_summary) == 0L) {
  stop("batch confounding summary is empty")
}
summary_path <- file.path(plot_root, "batch_confounding_summary.csv")
write_batch_analysis_table(batch_confounding_summary, summary_path)
stopifnot(file.exists(summary_path), file.info(summary_path)$size > 0)
```

# Summary

```{r summary, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
summary_overview <- aggregate(
  cbind(sample_count, potential_confounding) ~ dataset + plot_type,
  data = batch_confounding_summary,
  FUN = function(value) sum(as.numeric(value), na.rm = TRUE)
)
summary_overview
```

# Covid19 temporal MDS and ANOSIM diagnostics

```{r covid19-temporal-plots, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE}
covid19_temporal_results <- .build_covid_temporal_plots(metadata_results[["Covid19_PBMC"]])
covid19_temporal_results$bins
covid19_temporal_results$anosim
```

Outputs are written under `plots/batch_effect_uncorrected_batchconfounding/`:

- `<dataset>.pdf`: configured `datasets.json` batch covariates.
- `<dataset>_extended.pdf`: deduplicated secondary biological and technical onboarding candidates.
- `batch_confounding_summary.csv` and its checksum sidecar: per-level counts, availability, and conservative potential-confounding flags.
